hypothesis: If the frozen final decoder reaches the original p95 and deformation gates when only the per-joint latent tensor is optimized with a tail-aligned objective, then decoder/64D latent capacity is sufficient and the original A0 failure is primarily objective/encoder-path underfit. If it cannot materially reduce p95, decoder/field capacity remains implicated.

intervention.latent_initialization: exact final teacher-encoder latent from sealed step-1536 checkpoint
intervention.row_l1_definition: sum_j abs(pred_ij - teacher_ij) on each supervised row
intervention.tail_definition: top 10 percent supervised rows by current row_l1; k=94 fixed before execution

classification.DECODER_LATENT_CAPACITY_SUFFICIENT_FOR_G: final row-L1 p95 <= 0.05 and deformation ratio <= 0.05
classification.TAIL_OBJECTIVE_MATERIAL_GAIN_BUT_GATE_NO: final p95 > 0.05 and relative p95 reduction from baseline >= 0.25
